description: UNDERSTANDING — Create a named, persistent list (a shortlist / stack you own) of providers or APIs. Requires an apis.io API key. Priced B1 (single-entity synthesis) — $0.01 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

members.description: Provider slugs and/or aids to seed the list.

name: create_list
